pretreatments.description: Mechanical pretreatment: Reduction of the A. tequilana bagasse to an average length of 0.5 cm by using a blade mill.
Dilute acid hydrolysis using hydrochloric acid (HCl) at different concentrations, temperatures, and hydrolysis times.
Dilute acid hydrolysis using sulfuric acid (H_2SO_4) at different concentrations, temperatures, and hydrolysis times.
Filtration through a 0.45 mm membrane to remove solid particles after the acid hydrolysis.
Anaerobic batch assays to determine the effect of the hydrolysates on methane production.
Anaerobic sequencing batch reactor (AnSBR) operation with a constant concentration of 10 g COD/L, at three different cycle times (5, 3 and 2 days).
Inoculation of the AnSBR with 10 g VSS/L of anaerobic granular sludge collected from a full-scale UASB reactor treating tequila vinasses effluents.
Adjustment of the initial pH to 7.5 prior to incubation.
Constant agitation (120 rpm) during the anaerobic digestion experiments.
Feeding of 400 mL of hydrolysate at an adjusted concentration of 8 g COD/L.
Measurement of methane production at standard conditions (0 °C and 1 atm) using a National Instruments cRIO9004 device.
